about.title: Susanville Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: A defective product can turn an ordinary day in Susanville into a trip to the hospital, whether it's a malfunctioning tool used on Paul Bunyan Road job sites, a faulty appliance in a home near Main Street, or unsafe farm equipment out toward Skyline Road. California law generally allows injured people to pursue a strict liability claim, meaning the focus is on whether the product itself was defective, not on proving the manufacturer was careless. That distinction matters in a smaller community like Susanville, where getting timely medical care and understanding your options can feel overwhelming without local guidance. We review defective product cases and can explain what preserving the product and documenting your injury might mean for your situation. There's no cost for an initial consultation, and we work on contingency, so you owe nothing unless there's a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Strict Liability Can Work in Your Favor

items.title: No Need to Prove Negligence
items.desc: Under California's strict liability approach, you generally don't have to show the manufacturer was careless, just that the product was defective and caused harm.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable, which may widen the paths available to you.

items.title: The Product Itself Is Evidence
items.desc: Keeping the defective item intact, rather than discarding or repairing it, can be important since it may serve as central proof of a design, manufacturing, or warning defect.

items.question: Do I have to prove the manufacturer was negligent?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California's strict liability standard generally focuses on whether the product itself was defective in design, manufacturing, or warnings, and whether that defect caused your injury. We can review your specific facts to see how this standard applies.

items.question: What should I do with the product that injured me?
items.answer: Try to preserve it exactly as it was at the time of the injury, including packaging, instructions, and any remaining parts. This can be valuable evidence, so avoid repairing or discarding it before speaking with us.

items.question: Is a defective product claim different in a smaller area like Susanville?
items.answer: The legal standards are the same statewide, but local factors like where the product was purchased, used, or repaired in Lassen County can matter. Our team is familiar with the area and can help sort out those details.

items.question: Is there a charge for a case review?
items.answer: No. We provide a free initial consultation. We work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you receive a recovery.
